title: MemMA: Coordinating the Memory Cycle through Multi-Agent Reasoning and In-Situ Self-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2603.18718v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Memory-augmented LLM agents maintain external memory banks to support long-horizon interaction, yet most existing systems treat construction, retrieval, and utilization as isolated subroutines. This creates two coupled challenges: strategic blindness on the forward path of the memory cycle, where construction and retrieval are driven by local heuristics rather than explicit strategic reasoning, and sparse, delayed supervision on the backward path, where downstream failures rarely translate into direct repairs of the memory bank. translated_title: MemMA：通过多智能体推理与原位自我进化协调记忆循环
translated_abstract: 记忆增强的大语言模型智能体维护外部记忆库以支持长时程交互，然而大多数现有系统将记忆的构建、检索和利用视为相互孤立的子程序。这带来了两个相互耦合的挑战：一是记忆循环前向路径上的策略盲目性，即构建和检索由局部启发式规则而非显式的策略性推理所驱动；二是后向路径上稀疏且延迟的监督，即下游的失败很少能够转化为对记忆库的直接修复。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MemMA，一个即插即用的多智能体框架，沿前向和后向两条路径对记忆循环进行协调。在前向路径上，元思考者生成结构化引导，在记忆构建过程中指导记忆管理器，并在迭代检索过程中指挥查询推理器。在后向路径上，MemMA引入了原位自进化记忆构建机制
tldr: MemMA是一个即插即用的多智能体框架，通过前向路径上元思考者的策略性推理与后向路径上的原位自进化记忆构建，实现对记忆增强LLM智能体完整记忆循环的双向协调。
en_tdlr: MemMA is a plug-and-play multi-agent framework that coordinates the full memory cycle of memory-augmented LLM agents through strategic reasoning on the forward path via a Meta-Thinker and in-situ self-evolving memory construction on the backward path.
